topic: Is the Science Museum in London open on Sundays, and when does it open?

text: @claude is the Science Museum in London open on Sundays? And what time does it open?

Yes, the Science Museum is open on Sundays, and most listings say it opens at 10:00 and closes at 18:00. I couldn't open the official site, and one listing gives a 17:00 close, so check sciencemuseum.org.uk before you go. Sources: [Art Fund](https://www.artfund.org/explore/museums-and-galleries/science-museum), [Which Museum](https://whichmuseum.co.uk/museum/science-museum-london-48415/opening-hours).

Wonderlab isn't free walk-in. It's a paid extra, roughly £15–17 on the day, and it's cheaper if you book ahead. Booking ahead is also recommended for busy days.
